verdict.rationale: The pack shows a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (posthog.com/openapi.json returns HTTP 200, and per-endpoint OpenAPI 3.0 specs exist for generating SDK clients), plus static API docs such as the /query endpoint guide. None of it shows an interactive API reference with runnable, try-it-in-browser examples. A spec a developer could feed into their own explorer is a building block, not the capability itself, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
